epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease local environment setup time from >10 minutes to <1 minute
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root to start the full stack.
R2: Ensure the docker-compose stack exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Create docker-compose.yml for full stack launch
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization stack for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose file with a health-check, so that the product can be launched locally and verified in one command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean repository clone, When the user runs docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully, verified by automated checks.
Given the running stack, When the health-check endpoint is pinged, Then it returns a 200 OK status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual deployment steps from multiple commands to exactly 1 command

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to update or delete materials from >5 minutes (DB manual) to <30 seconds (UI)
requirements: R1: Provide UI functionality to update existing epidemiological materials by invoking the PUT API endpoint.
R2: Provide UI functionality to delete existing epidemiological materials by invoking the DELETE API endpoint.

slices.title: Implement update and delete UI for materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the update and delete actions for this epic, I want to patch the existing UI components, so that users can manage existing materials directly from the browser.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material, When a user edits it in the UI, Then the PUT API is called and the list updates, covered by UI tests.
Given an existing material, When a user deletes it, Then the DELETE API is called and the material is removed from view, covered by UI tests.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase UI operation coverage for catalog items from read-only to 100% CRUD

epics.title: Authentication and Session Management
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease unauthorized access success rate from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated users from accessing the catalog or creating materials.
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in.

slices.title: Implement authentication checks and login prompt
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to enforce session checks and display a login prompt, so that restricted epidemiological protocols are protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog, Then they are blocked and receive a 401/403 response, verified by auth tests.
Given an unauthenticated user blocked from access, When they are redirected, Then they are prompted to log in via the UI, verified by UI tests.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthenticated session lifespan to 0 seconds
